notes: This configuration is for deterministic technical simulation only.
The synthetic_model_id exercises all B/S/V component paths and is not a Phase 0 model-selection decision.
Component values in the simulator are non-negative deficits; q is their negative weighted composite and cannot exceed zero.
The synthetic recovery latency is monitoring-anchored. synthetic_pre_monitoring_latency_ms is added only to demonstrate T_total = T_pre + T_rec.
Phase 0 feature-model selection must use the separate prespecified measurement gates and must not use external clinical outcomes.
